question:
What should come in place of question mark in the following number series?

18¹⁹.⁸ ÷ 18⁸.⁷ × 18⁻².¹ = 18?²⁻⁷
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equate the exponents directly since the bases are identical: am ÷ aⁿ × ap = am−ⁿ⁺p.

⇒ 19.8 − 8.7 − 2.1 = ?² − 7

⇒ 9 = ?² − 7

⇒ ?² = 16 ⇒ ? = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**
